addr: 441, 9th Main Rd, HAL 2nd Stage, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560008, India

rev.t: This shop has a massive collection of items — everything from groceries, cooking essentials, fresh produce, and snacks to cleaning supplies, toiletries, and basic home needs. It’s a great place for both quick errands and bulk shopping. …
Quite a decent stock. Good variety. There is even a separate vegetable and fruit section.

They claim to keep expired products as well, so please check the expiration date before purchasing. We were advised to do this when we encountered an expired product and sought an exchange—it’s your responsibility.
